done_when: mcp_tool is gone from the binding kind union and from every branch and test, and stored definitions using it are rejected by the existing generic validation

findings.body: The new Postgres test writes a definition, then calls `semanticCapabilityFromToolCatalogItem` directly. It does not exercise the running API or agent selection path. That path calls the parser in `apps/core/src/application/agents/agent-tool-runtime-rules.ts:135-149` and is where an invalid stored capability must be rejected. The duplicate unit test also calls the parser directly, so neither test would catch a wiring regression that lets an unsupported binding reach an agent. Add an end-to-end flow through the running API with a real database and assert the stored definition is rejected.
findings.title: Not done: end-to-end test that stored unsupported bindings cannot reach an agent

why: The old mcp_tool capability binding is kept only to be rejected, yet seven files still branch on it
